name: domain-cert-tracker-mcp
description: Every client's domains and certificates in one inventory: what expires, unlocks or changes.

domain_cert_tracker_base_url.title: RDAP base URL
domain_cert_tracker_base_url.description: Optional. RDAP server used for single lookups (domain, nameserver, ip, autnum, bootstrap, certificates). Leave the prefilled default; sweep always routes each domain to its own registry. A server named here is reached even on a private address or another port, so set it only to a server you run or trust.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

domain_cert_tracker_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
domain_cert_tracker_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call (sweep, clients set, clients remove). Leave blank to keep every tool available.

domain_cert_tracker_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
domain_cert_tracker_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local store or response cache: single lookups still work, but sweep is refused. Leave blank to keep the local store.

domain_cert_tracker_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
domain_cert_tracker_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to RDAP servers and crt.sh. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

domain_cert_tracker_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
domain_cert_tracker_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
